articles.title: Xi Jinping calls China and DPRK to advance socialist cause and modernization
articles.summary: Xi Jinping met with North Korea's Premier Pak Thae Song in Beijing and called for both nations to strengthen strategic confidence and advance their respective socialist causes and modernization efforts.

articles.title: Xi Jinping delivers speech at commemorative meeting for CPC's 105th founding anniversary
articles.summary: Xi Jinping, as general secretary of the CPC Central Committee, delivered a speech at the commemorative gathering marking the 105th anniversary of the Communist Party of China's founding.

articles.title: Xi Jinping calls for solid measures to modernize agriculture and rural areas
articles.summary: Xi Jinping urged the adoption of solid measures to advance the modernization of agriculture and rural zones during an inspection tour in Shandong Province.

articles.title: Xi urges Party members to carry forward revolutionary traditions in response to centenarian member
articles.summary: Xi Jinping responded to a 102-year-old Communist Party member, urging all Party members to maintain revolutionary traditions and continue efforts toward the Party's cause.
